intended_object: The differential ∂⁻ of the unblocked grid chain complex GC⁻(G) (Ozsváth–Stipsicz–Szabó, Grid Homology, §4.6). It is the R[V₀,…,V_{n-1}]-linear map with ∂⁻x = Σ_y Σ_{r ∈ Rect°(x,y), r∩𝕏=∅} V₀^{O₀(r)}⋯V_{n-1}^{O_{n-1}(r)} · y. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The body is Finsupp.lsum applied to the generator map x ↦ unblockedDifferentialOnGenerator x. So it is the unique MvPolynomial-linear map on the free module over grid states that sends each generator x to Σ_y (unblockedCoefficient x y)·y. The coefficient unblockedCoefficient x y sums OMonomial r over the unblockedRectangles from x to y. Those are the empty rectangles from x to y whose covered squares avoid all X-markings, which is OSS's Rect°(x,y) with r∩𝕏=∅. OMonomial r is the product of V_c over the columns whose O-marking lies in r. An embedded rectangle covers each O at most once, so this equals V^{O(r)}, and indexing the O-markings by column is a harmless relabeling.

OSS work over 𝔽₂. This definition works over an arbitrary commutative semiring R, which is more general, not narrower. The module doc states plainly that ∂² = 0 only in characteristic 2 and that signs come later, so nothing is misrepresented. The construction is grid-diagram specific and has no general Mathlib counterpart. It matches the standard definition.
